# `trim`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Removes the leading and trailing space characters from `str`.

trim(BOTH FROM str) - Removes the leading and trailing space characters from `str`.

trim(LEADING FROM str) - Removes the leading space characters from `str`.

trim(TRAILING FROM str) - Removes the trailing space characters from `str`.

trim(trimStr FROM str) - Remove the leading and trailing `trimStr` characters from `str`.

trim(BOTH trimStr FROM str) - Remove the leading and trailing `trimStr` characters from `str`.

trim(LEADING trimStr FROM str) - Remove the leading `trimStr` characters from `str`.

trim(TRAILING trimStr FROM str) - Remove the trailing `trimStr` characters from `str`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
trim(str)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- trim, example 1
> SELECT trim('    SparkSQL   ');
SparkSQL
```

```sql
-- trim, example 2
> SELECT trim(BOTH FROM '    SparkSQL   ');
SparkSQL
```

```sql
-- trim, example 3
> SELECT trim(LEADING FROM '    SparkSQL   ');
SparkSQL   
```

```sql
-- trim, example 4
> SELECT trim(TRAILING FROM '    SparkSQL   ');
    SparkSQL
```

```sql
-- trim, example 5
> SELECT trim('SL' FROM 'SSparkSQLS');
parkSQ
```

```sql
-- trim, example 6
> SELECT trim(BOTH 'SL' FROM 'SSparkSQLS');
parkSQ
```

```sql
-- trim, example 7
> SELECT trim(LEADING 'SL' FROM 'SSparkSQLS');
parkSQLS
```

```sql
-- trim, example 8
> SELECT trim(TRAILING 'SL' FROM 'SSparkSQLS');
SSparkSQ
```
